**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Site Development and Hosting Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation of any kind:

- **§3 (Fees; Payment)** sets a fixed revenue-share — 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month — with no requirement that the Company extend to HDI any better terms given to third parties, and no obligation to match competing offers.
- Targeted searches for MFN indicia ("favorable", "most favoured/favored", "best", "price", "rates", "terms and conditions offered") returned no responsive language.
- The only covenant restricting the Company is the **§6.1 exclusivity/non-compete** (softened by §6.2's retained closeout-site right). That is a scope restriction, not a best-terms or price-matching mechanic, and it falls under the exclusivity rule — so I did not flag the same commercial term twice.

This sits at the **preferred position** for the MFN rule: no MFN obligation burdening the Customer. Noted in the rationale but not flagged: there is likewise no MFN running in our favour, which would be welcome but is not something this rule requires.
